hypothesis: Passive offer entries under SSR fill at least 50% of the time within 15 minutes with adverse selection under 0.5%, measured on free data: one-second listing-venue bars with the cached opening book as the arrival state (H2 on a bar fill model).
cohort: Verified reverse splits (primary_schedule_matched or structured_corporate_action) with an observed ex+1 open-to-close path; frozen run 20261013T224003582762Z; SSR-restricted sessions only
horizon: entry window 15 minutes after the open
cost_model: bar fill model: the offer rests at the cached venue best offer one second after the open, behind that level's displayed size; each later second's volume is spread uniformly over the bar's price range and the part at or above the offer depletes the queue ahead, then fills the order at the offer price; no cancellations are credited and no re-pricing is modeled; adverse selection is the one-second bar close five minutes after completion minus the fill price, over the arrival midpoint
metric: fill rate and adverse selection
success: fill rate >= 50% and adverse selection < 0.5% on validation
split: train 2018-05-01..2022-12-31; validate 2023-01-01..2024-12-31; holdout 2025-01-01 onward sealed until the program's final review

hypothesis: Participation at 1% of first-hour printed volume costs under 1.5% round trip, measured on free data: one-second listing-venue bars with the cached opening and closing books for the arrival midpoint and the spread (H3 on a bar model).
cohort: Verified reverse splits (primary_schedule_matched or structured_corporate_action) with an observed ex+1 open-to-close path; frozen run 20261013T224003582762Z

cost_model: a fixed share of every one-second bar's volume (the opening cross removed) at the bar's range midpoint; the entry arrival is the cached midpoint one second after the open; the exit arrival is the 15:00 bar's range midpoint; cost = entry shortfall + exit shortfall + crossing fraction x the cached half-spreads (open book for the entry leg, close book for the cover), over the entry arrival midpoint; no market impact beyond the spread term
metric: round-trip cost as a fraction of gross exposure

hypothesis: Removing opening snapshot admission and including assumed SSR compliant fills increases dollar opportunity coverage; delayed entry and cover liquidity may offset the increase.
cohort: All 551 already examined primary ex+1 events in 2023-01-03..2026-10-13, including 325 SSR-active at the open. No forecast-profit filter, full-opening-depth admission, 3% opening anchor or three-name cap.
horizon: 30/60/120/240 minute entries, same-day conditional covers
exit: From 90 minutes before close to 15 minutes before close, buy at sampled ask, taking at most 5% of observed volume. Residual assumes completion at the final observed ask plus 5/2/1% surcharge. All residual completions flagged and retained in P&L, with +20%/+100% gap loss sensitivity. This is conditional same-day completion, not proof of flatness.
cost_model: Entry uses contemporaneous sampled bid (unrestricted) or bid-plus-tick (restricted), with adverse bar-range midpoint adjustment for unrestricted flow. Extra impact 25/10/5 bps per side. Entry amount capped at target in dollars before fees. No legacy 3.11% proxy or duplicated spread/depth addition. IBKR Pro Fixed 0.005/share, $1 minimum, 1% notional cap per occupied five-minute child bucket per side; current SEC 20.60/million sold, normal TAF .000195/share capped9.79 per sell child, CAT .000003/share both sides, cents rounded up. Cover residual is a separate child. Replacements within a five-minute child assumed not to restart its minimum.
metric: Dollars per year, actual modeled position size, SSR coverage, drawdown, margin, conditional cover shares and required participation.
success: Publish all48 declared variants with assumptions and coverage; no profit threshold or winning variant promotion.
kill: No executable or production-profit claim without approved borrow, compliant order fills and validated residual covers.
split: Retrospective assumption sensitivity, all 48 variants retained, no new untouched holdout claim. Designated execution holdout file remains unread. No production strategy change, broker orders or paid downloads.

cost_model: Reuse H21 flow replay, all two targets/four windows/three combined cases. Both entry and cover participation increase to the specified rate of recorded venue flow. SSR capture unchanged. success: Retain all48 additional rate/size/window/cost variants, without promoting a winner.
kill: No measured impact, broker fill, locate or production profitability claim from a higher assumed participation rate.
split: Declared after seeing all H21 results and before any H22 replay. Retrospective capacity/cost sensitivity, all 48 extra variants retained. No winning rate promoted and no additional data or trading authority.
